description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. Supersedes build-0010, which expected integer counts where the rule states arrays. AGSC-06-33 states /graph/fragments/index.json as {subjects, predicates, generated_at}, JCS-canonical, with subjects and predicates ARRAYS OF FILE PATHS in code-point order, and AGSC-00-03 makes the rule normative. Derivation: one subject fragment per distinct subject IRI and one predicate fragment per distinct predicate IRI of graph.nq, each named by the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the IRI — sha256('https://a.example/concepts/b/')[0:16] = 098c1a9f71408651, sha256('https://a.example/concepts/a/')[0:16] = 6f1ba47e10c664e3, sha256('http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#prefLabel')[0:16] = 841f92a1f63b1bac — the two subject paths in code-point order ('0' before '6'), no object fragments at 1.x, and generated_at the build instant. A writer that emits no fragments emits no index.
